failure_policy: Stop at first failed generation or campaign deadline; no replacement samples or repeated campaigns.

decision_rule.scope: Exploratory candidate eligibility only, not release acceptance, semantic equivalence or a production SLA.
decision_rule.correctness: All planned generations saved; one grounded question except pause; no observed public identity, actor, uncertainty, language, photo/reference or pause defect; actual candidate-history rollback works. Schema success alone does not prove semantic equivalence.
decision_rule.latency: Both paired median meaningful-public-text and usable-save times must improve. First/later/resumed pairs must improve in both languages. No paired case may have candidate save time over 1.20 times baseline; this is a frozen exploratory regression guard, not a user-agreed SLA.
decision_rule.quality: Retain the complete legacy prompt, current narration and matched pre-turn history. Any observed quality loss blocks promotion regardless of speed.

measurement: Existing backend streaming campaign, real private-worker Codex app-server and live gateway; in-memory external storage and controlled optional workspace adapters. No browser paint, durable SQL latency, live image perception or live workspace extraction is measured.
provider_limits: Outer gateway retries stay zero. Exact per-generation upstream retry attribution may be unavailable; report allowlisted receipts separately, never assume one app-server turn means one provider request.
local_gateway_changes: Added one GPT-prefixed alias reusing existing low route/key and zero outer retry policy.
Added only that alias to the existing Memoir consumer model allowlist.
Restarted only LiteLLM with explicit user approval; verified existing max/low key policies read-only.
remaining_release_gates: Representative semantic-quality and real extraction grounding evidence beyond this small synthetic/stress workload.
Final-head full-suite verification with required environment prerequisites.
Prompt-only/combined matched comparisons if pursuing prompt reduction.
Approval for an optimized default/rollout; normal collector remains max/legacy.
profiler_only_change: Archive copy preserves tenant ownership/modes in isolated candidate history. Normal worker permissions unchanged.
